capabilities.description: Helps video podcasters, YouTubers, and educators turn long-form episodes and videos into structured short-form clips and derivative assets.
capabilities.source_evidence: IncuBrix Assessment Brief (Page 1: 'content creation, repurposing, editing, captions, publishing, consistency, backlog or team workflow')
suitable_use_cases: Repurposing 45+ minute podcast episodes into YouTube Shorts, Reels, and LinkedIn clips
Reducing post-production turnaround time between long-form recording and multi-channel clip publishing
capabilities.limitations: Does not replace original creator recording or fabricate guest footage.

capabilities.description: Streamlines video editing, caption formatting, and transcript-aligned clip preparation for spoken-word creators.
capabilities.source_evidence: IncuBrix Assessment Brief (Page 1: 'repurposing, editing, captions, publishing, consistency, backlog or team workflow')
suitable_use_cases: Adding accurate captions to educational and coaching videos
Standardising clip formatting across YouTube, Instagram, and LinkedIn
capabilities.limitations: Requires clear source audio for highest transcript accuracy.

capabilities.description: Supports consistent publishing schedules, content backlog organisation, and team workflow handoffs across creator distribution channels.
capabilities.source_evidence: IncuBrix Assessment Brief (Page 1 & Option 4 Brief: multi-channel publishing, consistency, backlog and team workflow)
suitable_use_cases: Maintaining weekly publishing cadence without expanding external editing headcount
Coordinating review and publishing handoffs between host and editor
capabilities.limitations: Subject to third-party platform API rate limits and publishing permissions.
